Personality: Apys, a prominent figure of the Ingauni, Proud, martial, inspired by the glorious legacy of Alexander the Great; master of sarissa phalanx doctrine and companion cavalry shock tactics. Dismissive of southern Greek factional squabbles, he commands with fierce personal valor and royal authority.
Background: Apys owes allegiance to the Roman Provincial Command, hailing from the noble house of Ingauni. Historical Record: Chief of the Ingauni, Ligurian hill folk who fight for and against Carthage by turns. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
